name: java-frontend
body: The Java frontend artifact (`src/javalib/CallGraphBuilder.java`). It walks compilation units and emits module/package scaffolding. Must give default-package sources a root module so their classes are reachable, rather than returning early on the empty package. Build-time deps: `javac` with `--release 21` (JDK >= 21). Scan-time deps: `java` (JDK >= 21) on PATH — the scan driver spawns it as `java -Xmx5g -cp <dir> CallGraphBuilder`. Engine pin: the runtime JDK's `javac` via `ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler()`; the language-version ceiling is the installed JDK (>= 21).
